# Vendored browser assets

These files are copied into the project so the HTML prototypes remain usable without external network access.

| Asset | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tailwind CSS Play CDN | 3.4.17 | https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.17 | MIT |
| Lucide | 1.62.0 | https://unpkg.com/lucide@1.62.0/dist/umd/lucide.min.js | ISC |
| Font Awesome Free | 6.4.0 | https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/ | Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1; Icons: CC BY 4.0; Code: MIT |
| Inter variable font | Current RSMS release | https://rsms.me/inter/font-files/InterVariable.woff2 | SIL OFL 1.1 |

Do not edit upstream vendor files directly. When upgrading, update this manifest and rerun the offline smoke test.
